alarm_enabled: Allow the silent alarm on all computers
alarm_hint: A user presses a key combination on their computer and the chosen recipients get a message at once. Nothing appears on the computer where it was pressed. For reception desks, counters and anyone who may need help without drawing attention.
alarm_hotkey_hint: Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win plus a function key (Ctrl+Shift+F12), or two of them plus a character (Ctrl+Shift+Ü – only on keyboard layouts that have it). Choose one nobody presses by accident and that no other program uses.
alarm_limits_hint: While an alarm from a computer is open, pressing again there changes nothing. At most 5 alarms per 10 minutes are raised on this server; further ones are only logged.
alarm_placeholders: {user} and {computer} are replaced by who pressed the keys and where.
delay_hint: Short blips that recover within this time never reach a screen.
deploy_msi_hint: One installer for every computer. Works with any software-deployment tool; updates and uninstalls cleanly.
deploy_script_hint: For a quick test on a single computer, with the plain executable.
deploy_token_hint: These commands contain the client token. It lets a computer read messages, nothing else.
download_package: Download the package for this server
drafts_hint: From monitoring or your service provider, not shown to anyone yet.
hub_error: Not connected to the service provider:
hub_ok: Connected to your service provider, last contact
install_cmd: Command for deployment tools: install or update, silently
integrations_hint: One webhook per monitoring system. Problems open a message, recoveries resolve it.
labels: Labels in front of the title
license_none: No license – free up to {free} computers ({n} connected).
license_note_hub: A hub needs a hub license. Enter it as LICENSE_KEY.
license_note_invalid: The license key does not work: {state}.
license_note_offline: The license portal cannot be reached right now. The license stays valid until {until}.
license_note_over: The license covers {max} computers, {n} are connected.
license_note_stale: The license portal has not been reachable since {since}, so the license could not be confirmed.
license_note_unlicensed: {n} computers use Statusbar. Up to {free} it is free; for more, please enter a license as LICENSE_KEY.
license_note_unverified: The license portal cannot be reached, the license has not been confirmed yet.
login_hint_directory: Use your directory account. Only members of the administrator group may sign in.
login_hint_standalone: Use the ADMIN_TOKEN from the server configuration.
name: Name
new_incident_hint: Appears on the targeted screens within a second.
no_msi: This server has no installer. Release images include it; for a self-built server, build Statusbar.msi (see docs/CLIENT.md) and place it at /data/Statusbar.msi.
over_fullscreen: Stay visible above full-screen windows (remote desktop, presentations)
package_hint: A ZIP with the installer and install.cmd / uninstall.cmd, already filled in with this server and its client token.
pattern_hint: Wildcards: * and ?. Compared with "host/service", the alert key and its title.
rdp_hide: Hide the bar on that monitor – the client on the session host shows it inside the session
rdp_mode: When a Remote Desktop session fills a monitor
rdp_mode_hint: Applies to the classic Remote Desktop client. "Hide" (default) needs the client installed on your session hosts as well – without it, users in a full-screen session see no message; choose "Show the bar on top of it" then. Sessions across several monitors hide the bar on each of them. "Take out of full screen" only acts on single-monitor sessions and restores full screen after the all-clear.
rdp_overlay: Show the bar on top of it
rdp_windowed: Experimental: take the session out of full screen while a message is shown
rules_hint: Translate technical alerts into words your users understand. The first matching rule wins and is published without approval.
sound_missing: No file uploaded yet – this kind stays silent until you add one.
sounds_hint: Desktops play a sound when a new message appears – once, for the most urgent new one. Windows sounds follow each computer's sound scheme and volume. Your own sounds: WAV, up to 1 MB. Never on the computer that raised a silent alarm.
stage_draft: This is how it will look
stage_draft_note: Nobody sees it until you publish.
stage_live_note: Desks show this bar right now. Several messages take turns.
stage_quiet_note: No bar on any desk. Publish a message or let your monitoring do it.
subtitle: Subtitle
team_exists: A notification group with this name exists.
teams_hint: Combine computers, users, directory groups and OUs under one name, for example Finance team. Choose it as recipient under Messages. A connected service provider sees the names and can address them too.
title: Title
token_once: Copy this now – the token is shown only once.
tk_auth_glpi: The API token of a GLPI user (My settings → Remote access keys) with an empty user name – or user name and password. The legacy REST API must be enabled (Setup → General → API).
tk_auth_jira: Cloud: e-mail address and API token. Data Center: a personal access token with an empty user name.
tk_auth_servicenow: User name and password of an integration user (roles itil and rest_api_explorer or web_service_admin) – or an OAuth token with an empty user name.
tk_auth_topdesk: Login name of an operator and an application password (My settings → Application passwords).
tk_auth_webhook: Optional. A token without user name is sent as "Authorization: Bearer …", with a user name as HTTP Basic.
tk_auth_zammad: An access token (Profile → Token Access, permission ticket.agent) with an empty user name – or user name and password.
tk_auth_znuny: Agent login and password. Needs the web service "Statusbar" from integrations/znuny-otrs.
tk_clear_secret: Remove the stored password or token
tk_close_glpi: Status when closing: 5 solved or 6 closed
tk_close_jira: Transition ID for closing (empty: comment only)
tk_customer_jira: On behalf of (account ID or e-mail, optional)
tk_hint: Statusbar opens a ticket when a message is published or a silent alarm is raised, and adds a note and closes it when the message is resolved. Tickets opened here never come back as a second message through an inbound ticket integration.
tk_on_alarm: a silent alarm is raised (the ticket is closed when the alarm ends)
tk_on_resolve: a message without a ticket is resolved (a ticket as a record)
tk_placeholders_hint: Empty fields use the default shown in grey. A line whose placeholders are all empty is left out.
tk_priorities_hint: For Outage, Degraded, Notice and Silent alarm. Empty fields use the value shown in grey.
tk_resolve_close: Add a note and close the ticket
tk_secret_set: set – leave empty to keep it
tk_statusbar_url: Address of this Statusbar server, for {url}
tk_target_jira: Service desk ID / request type ID
tk_untested: Built from the vendor documentation, not tested against a live instance. Try it with "Create test ticket" first.
tk_webhook_hint: Sent when the message is published ({event} = created) and when it is resolved ({event} = resolved, {ticket_body} = the note). Values are inserted JSON-escaped, so put placeholders inside quotes. An answer with "id" and "url" is shown with the message.
